title: Notifications
subtitle: Manage provider visit notifications.
business_help: Receive these notifications on devices you have activated with your account.

permission_required: Allow notifications to receive them on this device.

invalid_endpoint: The browser did not provide a valid subscription.
invalid_revision: The subscription status could not be checked.
invalid_subscription_keys: The browser did not provide a valid subscription.
registration_unavailable: The push notification service is currently unavailable.
subscription_rebind_mismatch: The subscription changed. Enable notifications again.
